pages.text: Right-click **still water** to place, like a lily pad: a float and a pole with a glowing lamp. Boats and mobs pass through it.

**Linking:** right-click one buoy with a [[linking_bar]], then the next, up to **32 blocks** apart. Each buoy takes two links, so courses are lines or loops. Shift + right-click with the bar to unlink.

**Switching off:** right-click a buoy to turn its lamp off. A boat heading for it stops about 2 blocks short and waits until it's switched back on.
**Advanced buoys** link up to **64 blocks** apart to each other. A boat needs the [[advanced_antenna_upgrade]] to follow a leg over 32 blocks.
